PSYCHOLOGICAL HORROR SCREENWRITING FOR SHORT FILM


$30-100 USD

Open

Posted about 15 hours ago

•

Ends in 6 days


$30-100 USD

Paid on delivery

I’m looking for a screenwriter/co-writer to help turn a fairly developed psychological horror short into a polished, production-ready screenplay of approximately 18–22 pages. I’m a film student/indie filmmaker in Kentucky, and this short is being produced for a competition later this month, so I need someone who can work quickly and communicate reliably. The basic story, characters, themes, and visual concepts, are already developed. I mainly need a strong writer to help turn my existing material into an effective screenplay, especially the dialogue. The film is grounded relationship horror about Alex and Robin, a couple whose relationship gradually becomes emotionally and physically unsafe. Alex sometimes dissociates, which is represented visually through a glamorous, decaying cabaret/variety-show world in his mind. The external story remains realistic; the performance sequences are subjective cinematic imagery rather than a supernatural plot device. Tonal influences include The Invisible Man (2020), Run, The Act, Obsession, and the visual/theatrical atmosphere of American Horror Story: Freak Show. What I’m looking for: * Strong, naturalistic dialogue * Psychological horror and tension * Complicated, believable relationship dynamics * Characters who are flawed without becoming caricatures * Proper screenplay formatting * Approximately 18–22 pages * One completed draft plus one light revision pass Budget: $100 USD fixed (up to $150 if quality requires it). This is my absolute budget ceiling, so I want to be upfront about that from the beginning. Credit: “Written by Jett & [Writer]” The finished short is genuinely being produced, so this would be a produced screenplay credit rather than a speculative script. Important: No generative AI may be used to write, rewrite, or generate any portion of the screenplay. Additional Detail: Recorded covers of the actor set to play Alex singing “I Wanna Be Loved by You,” “Dream a Little Dream of Me,” “Sing You Sinners,” “Button Up Your Overcoat,” and “I’m Always Chasing Rainbows” are available for use in the film.
